slides.texte_overlay:
my habits as an academic
and active perfectionist
pt 2

i plan tomorrow tonight.
three tasks, written by hand,
before i close my laptop.

i walk to class every day.
it's my best thinking time.

i redo every question
i got wrong until i can
explain why.

i study in 50-minute blocks,
then 10 minutes away
from the desk.

i keep sunday mornings free.
rest is part of the plan.

i always learn beyond
the syllabus. a little art,
history or science
every day.
slides.texte_sophia:
i always learn beyond
the syllabus. i take 5-minute
lessons on a micro-learning
app like the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
and yes, there is always
